SOURCE DATA (classify expressed structure, not world truth):
STAGE GATES: create test_live_ab.py, explicit scripts/run_live_ab.py or equivalent, make check-s3 for offline tests and validating existing evidence, make check-s3-live to initiate one bounded real turn, make package-s3 to freeze reproducible S3 source archive with fresh-extraction tests and promote to integration ONLY if real evidence is accepted. Define evidence/live_ab.json with exact observed Looper provider thread/turn, graph addresses, correlation/attempt IDs, generation, transport observation and source/result commitment receipt. Negative tests: stale generation, mismatched correlation, wrong target/type, private child access, double commit, provider unavailable and uncertain no retry, restart replay. Preserve earlier 71 tests and frozen S0/S1/S2/S2.5 digests; run checks and one explicit live call. If provider is unavailable, leave S3 OPEN and do not manufacture a positive. No S4+.

logic:nested.instructions: One operator/predicate/flow is scoped inside another.

logic:chain.instructions: Multiple dependent inference/relation steps form a chain.

logic:shared_premise.instructions: One premise participates in more than one flow.

logic:branch.instructions: A premise/condition connects to multiple consequences.

logic:equivalence.instructions: Two formulas/claims are explicitly equivalent, not merely similar.

logic:substitution.instructions: An identity/equivalence licenses replacing a term/formula within a larger expression.

logic:missing_premise.instructions: An intended inference has a required premise that is absent.

axis:composition_topology.instructions: Classify the dominant composition of actual premise/conclusion dependencies.

criteria.chain: A conclusion feeds a later inference.
criteria.shared: Multiple flows share a premise without a serial chain.
criteria.none_or_unresolved: No supported composition or unclear topology.

axis:reference_alignment.instructions: Assess whether repeated terms in the proposed composition preserve referents and senses.

criteria.aligned: Same referents and senses are supported.

axis:composition_support.instructions: Assess source support for the larger connection, not philosophical truth.

criteria.licensed: Connection follows from supported component relations.

axis:equivalence_strength.instructions: Distinguish two directions from similarity or a single implication.

criteria.biconditional: Both conditional directions with matching terms.
criteria.none_or_unresolved: No equivalence candidate or unclear senses.

axis:context_dependence.instructions: Assess how much context is required for the proposed composition.

axis:assumption_sensitivity.instructions: Assess reliance on an unstated bridge, identity or interpretation.

criteria.independent: Composition does not require an unstated bridge.
